data.title: bn-2iw7: bounded Parquet projected row reads
data.description: Independent security and correctness review of the 0.1.1 candidate. Verify projection/window validation before decode, duplicate/unknown/unsupported handling, exact NULL/DECIMAL/timestamp semantics, one decode per selected page, aggregate allocation/output bounds, hostile/property coverage, immutable public 0.1.0, and retained Seal initialization.

data.reason: LGTM at 8ee102e95f4813c6c184b811186ef5108d895aaa. Projection and complete window/count/allocation validation precede page decode; duplicate, unknown, nested/repeated, and unsupported columns fail closed; each accepted projection index traverses selected pages once; linear transpose preserves exact typed Cell values and rejects count mismatches; aggregate bounds discard partial work. Hostile/equivalence/max-bound tests, full just check, reproducible build, and sigil-check pass. v0.1.0 remains the sole public tag; 0.1.1 is unpublished and capability-free.
